title: The best free AI writing tools for small businesses in 2026

facts.fact: eesel AI Blog Writer's free plan includes 100 credits with no credit card required.
facts.quote: **Free plan:** 100 free credits, no credit card required.

facts.fact: eesel AI Blog Writer charges $4.00 per blog post, covering research, writing, SEO, and images.
facts.quote: Per blog post | $4.00 each | Research + writing + SEO + images

facts.fact: eesel states that its voice matching has a claimed 94% voice match.
facts.quote: with a claimed 94% voice match

facts.fact: eesel AI Blog Writer offers an annual plan that gives two months free when paying a year upfront.
facts.quote: Annual | Two months free | Pay a year upfront

facts.fact: eesel AI Blog Writer add-ons (SSO and MFA, priority support) start at $199 per month.
facts.quote: Add-ons | From $199/mo | SSO and MFA, priority support

facts.fact: The eesel free plan's 100 credits are not refilled, and the agent pauses once they run out until a paid plan is chosen.
facts.quote: The free plan is generous but finite, with 100 credits and no refill.

facts.fact: Rytr's free plan provides 10,000 characters per month, free forever, with no credit card required.
facts.quote: **Free plan:** 10,000 characters per month (roughly 1,500-2,000 words). No credit card. Free forever.

facts.fact: Rytr's free plan includes 20+ pre-programmed tones of voice and one language.
facts.quote: The free plan covers 20+ pre-programmed tones of voice and one language.

facts.fact: Rytr offers 40+ use case templates.
facts.quote: 40+ use case templates

facts.fact: Rytr's Unlimited plan costs $7.50 per month when billed annually and includes custom tone training.
facts.quote: Custom tone training - so the tool outputs content that sounds specifically like your business - requires the Unlimited plan at $7.50/month billed annually.

facts.fact: Rytr's Premium plan costs $24.16 per month when billed annually.
facts.quote: | Premium | $24.16/mo (yearly) |
